issue.title: Local revival reads ignore the launch-time revival_inputs archive after chop/cleanup
issue.description:
Proposed by phase bead sase-w2.2 (epic sase-w2, prompt-capture-at-launch) as PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #1; verified still unaddressed by sase-w2.land on 2026-09-04 (no reference to revival_inputs anywhere under src/sase/ace).

Epic sase-w2 made publication prefer the launch-time revival-inputs archive (src/sase/core/revival_inputs.py, captured by src/sase/axe/run_agent_runner_setup.py; preferred by src/sase/agents_sync/inventory_sources.py), but the local revival surfaces still read only the live artifact: the TUI's Agent.get_raw_xprompt_content (src/sase/ace/tui/models/artifact_files.py) and the CLI restart path. After chop/cleanup removes live artifacts, local revival loses the prompt that the archive durably holds, so local revival and publication disagree on the same run.

Remediation: make both read paths prefer ~/.sase/revival_inputs with live-artifact fallback, mirroring inventory_sources.py.

Context: sase-w2.2's PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #2 (fold the revival_inputs store into the canonical-identity immutable archive that sase-w2.7 added) was declined by sase-w2.land as consolidation with no behavioral gap; revisit only if this task's implementation finds the split store a real obstacle.
